scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix apps/web && npm install --prefix apps/api
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/web && npm run build --prefix apps/api
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d --build redis storage storage-init && docker compose wait storage-init && docker compose exec -T redis redis-cli ping
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build --prefix apps/api && npm run start:worker --prefix apps/api
scripts.worker:up: docker compose --profile worker up -d --build --scale worker=2 worker
